Agents stake a bond locked in shale-backed escrow; joining requires proving a unique hardware root plus a small proof-of-work. Reputation accrues only at the network zenith after sustained honest epochs, so cheap throwaway sybils never reach reward tiers. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
